description: Prototype restrictions in Defk.Compiler: branch_type! rejects array-valued branches, and returned arrays must come from alloc/2. Cause: param array views are rebound on every resume, so copies held in frame vars would go stale after GC. Needs tracking of which view a variable refers to, or rebinding of all aliases on resume.

comments.text: Also hit by examples/rolling_stats.exs (defk-9p6.1): an if returning a tuple ({s1 - old, q1 - old * old} vs {s1, q1}) is rejected ('branches returning tuples are not supported'); rewrote it as a scalar if on the leaving sample. Tuple-valued branches are a natural Elixir idiom inside reduce bodies.

title: Allow arrays through if/cond branches and returning input arrays
